title: GraphQL & API Design
blurb: APIs explained from zero, then GraphQL end to end: the query language, schema design, resolvers, clients and their caches, security, performance at scale, and how to choose between REST, GraphQL and gRPC in an interview. Every idea runs in the page through small hand-written models of a GraphQL engine, plus 27 judged problems.
sources: apollographql.com/docs (Apollo Server, Client and Federation documentation)
